reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib moliyaviy talab (9-bet): Xizmat muddati 2026-yil 1-noyabrdan 31-dekabrgacha, ya'ni ikki oy, lot boshlang'ich narxi esa 65 707 040 so'm. Shunga qaramay, kamida uch oylik asosiy oziq-ovqat zaxirasini yig'ish va doimiy saqlash talab qilinadi; bu taxminan 85 mln so'm tovar zaxirasi demak (16 foiz ustamasiz oziq-ovqat qiymatidan hisoblanganda) va u lotning umumiy narxidan ham yuqori, shu sababli kichik ta'minotchilar qatnashishi cheklanishi mumkin.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib tajriba yoki resurs talabi (platformadagi mezonlar): To'liq 20 ball ishtirokchining o'zida oshxona jihozlari, omborxona, sovitkich, transport va inventar bo'lishiga bog'langan. Texnik topshiriqning 7.1-bandiga ko'ra esa buyurtmachi oshxona xonalari, jihozlar va inventarni ijrochiga foydalanishga beradi, 11.8-bandda ham transport va ombor faqat "mavjud bo'lsa" ko'rsatiladi. Shu sababli resursi yo'q, lekin xizmatni bajara oladigan ishtirokchi 10-20 ball yo'qotishi mumkin.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (3-bet): Ustama haq 15 va 16 foiz oralig'ida bo'lishi shart, ammo narx qismi 30 ball bilan baholanadi: Ball = (eng past ustama / taklif etilgan ustama) x 30. Shu sababli narx bo'yicha farq ko'pi bilan 2 ball atrofida bo'ladi va 15 foizdan past ustama bilan ishlay oladigan ishtirokchi qatnasha olmaydi. Tanlash hujjatlarida esa faqat 16 foizdan yuqori takliflar rad etilishi yozilgan, pastki chegara haqida gap yo'q.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib tajriba yoki resurs talabi (platformadagi mezonlar): Ikki oylik, 65 707 040 so'mlik xizmat uchun oxirgi 3 yilda 5 tadan ko'p tashkilotga xizmat ko'rsatgan va tavsiyanoma olgan ishtirokchi 15 ball oladi, 1-2 ta tashkilotli ishtirokchi esa atigi 1 ball. reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Financial demand out of proportion to the lot (page 9): The service runs for two months (1 November to 31 December 2026) and the lot start price is 65,707,040 UZS. Yet a standing reserve of at least three months of staple food is required, roughly 85 million UZS of stock (estimated from the food cost without the 16 percent mark-up), which is more than the whole lot price and may keep smaller suppliers out.

Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot (platform criteria form): The full 20 points require the bidder to hold kitchen equipment, a warehouse, refrigeration, transport and inventory. Yet item 7.1 of the specification says the customer hands over kitchen premises, equipment and inventory, and item 11.8 asks for transport and storage only "if available". A bidder without its own assets that could still do the job may lose 10-20 points.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 3): The mark-up must lie between 15 and 16 percent, although the price part is worth 30 points by the formula (lowest mark-up / offered mark-up) x 30. Price can therefore change the result by only about 2 points, and a bidder able to work at a mark-up below 15 percent cannot take part. The tender document itself only says bids above 16 percent are rejected and states no lower limit.

Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot (platform criteria form): For a two-month service worth 65,707,040 UZS, a bidder with more than 5 served organisations and recommendation letters in the last 3 years gets 15 points, while one with 1-2 organisations gets only 1 point. New or small contractors can lose up to 14 points, which may be decisive in the technical part.
Note: 5 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.

   Savolimiz: To'liq 20 ball ishtirokchining o'zida oshxona jihozlari, omborxona, sovitkich, transport va inventar bo'lishiga bog'langan. Texnik topshiriqning 7.1-bandiga ko'ra esa buyurtmachi oshxona xonalari, jihozlar va inventarni ijrochiga foydalanishga beradi, 11.8-bandda ham transport va ombor faqat "mavjud bo'lsa" ko'rsatiladi. Shu sababli resursi yo'q, lekin xizmatni bajara oladigan ishtirokchi 10-20 ball yo'qotishi mumkin.
   Taklif etilayotgan tahrir: Ball ishtirokchi xizmatni bajarish uchun zarur resurslarni (o'ziniki, ijaraga olingan yoki buyurtmachi taqdim etadiganlarni hisobga olgan holda) ta'minlay olishi, xususan transport va xodimlar mavjudligi bo'yicha berilsin.

3. Texnik topshiriq, 3-bet.
   Hujjatdagi matn: «Taklif etiladigan ustama haqi miqdori l6 foizdan oshmasligi hamda 15 foizdan kam bo'lmasligi lozim»
   Savolimiz: Ustama haq 15 va 16 foiz oralig'ida bo'lishi shart, ammo narx qismi 30 ball bilan baholanadi: Ball = (eng past ustama / taklif etilgan ustama) x 30. Shu sababli narx bo'yicha farq ko'pi bilan 2 ball atrofida bo'ladi va 15 foizdan past ustama bilan ishlay oladigan ishtirokchi qatnasha olmaydi. Tanlash hujjatlarida esa faqat 16 foizdan yuqori takliflar rad etilishi yozilgan, pastki chegara haqida gap yo'q.
   Taklif etilayotgan tahrir: Ustama haq faqat yuqori chegara (16 foiz) bilan cheklansin yoki pastki chegara tanlash hujjatlarida ham aniq va asoslangan holda ko'rsatilsin.

4. Elektron tizimdagi baholash mezonlari.
   Hujjatdagi matn: «Xizmat ko‘rsatgan tashkilotlardan kamida 5 ta tavsiyanoma ilova qilinadi. Ma’lumotlar jadval shaklida tasdiqlangan bo‘lishi lozim. 15 ball – 5 tadan ko‘p tashkilot va tavsiyanomalari mavjud bo‘lsa.»
   Savolimiz: Ikki oylik, 65 707 040 so'mlik xizmat uchun oxirgi 3 yilda 5 tadan ko'p tashkilotga xizmat ko'rsatgan va tavsiyanoma olgan ishtirokchi 15 ball oladi, 1-2 ta tashkilotli ishtirokchi esa atigi 1 ball. Yangi yoki kichik ijrochilar 14 ballgacha yo'qotadi, bu esa texnik qismda hal qiluvchi farq bo'lishi mumkin.
   Taklif etilayotgan tahrir: Oxirgi 3 yilda bolalar yoki ta'lim muassasalarida ovqatlantirish xizmatini ko'rsatgan kamida 1 ta shartnoma mavjudligi tasdiqlansa, to'liq ball berilsin; tavsiyanomalar soni bo'yicha keskin farq qo'llanilmasin.

Mazkur shartlarga aniqlik kiritilishi xarid predmetini yetkazib bera oladigan barcha ishtirokchilarning teng sharoitda qatnashishiga va raqobatning kengayishiga xizmat qiladi, deb hisoblaymiz.
